title: A modern workspace
description: Separate from the original editor. Fly through the scene, then switch to a zoomable map.

title: Build, undo, redo
description: Fill a selected area with a terrain brush. Undo and redo the complete edit.

title: Copy a little. Build a lot.
description: Reusable stamps copy both layers. Rotate the pattern and place it again.

title: Place scenery precisely
description: Browse textured model previews from both discs, then snap, nudge and ground scenery.

title: Two games. One map.
description: T1 and T2 Rikimaru share this courtyard. A visual gallery previews both games before selection.

title: Give characters a route
description: Extend a patrol using the original adjacency, facing and wait rules.

title: Light the scene instantly
description: Preview daylight, sunset and lantern-lit night, with modern lighting and shadows.

title: Change the atmosphere
description: Clear skies, a rainstorm and windblown snow. Seek two minutes of ground accumulation instantly while gameplay stays at tick zero.

title: Draw an event region
description: Select map cells and create a 3D trigger. Add messages, flags and delayed actions.

title: Queue sounds from both games
description: Audition a T1 effect, then a T2 effect. Music, volume and pan are also editable.

title: Play what you build
description: Run the actual mission and its timed storm, then return to the unchanged editing workspace.

title: Keep and share your work
description: Save events, views and stamps with build provenance. Projects also opens campaign maps for terrain editing; Assets bundles custom models, textures and audio into shared maps.

title: Keep your best angles
description: Switch between named camera views. Hide guides for clean scene previews.

title: Your next mission starts here
description: Open the editable T1 + T2 garden example. Both discs required; scenery is decorative.
